A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus**. It takes ~25 minutes, uses one skillet, and requires minimal prep.

**Recipe:**
1. Pound 2 chicken breasts to even thickness; season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
2. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, 4–5 min/side until golden and 165°F internal. Remove.
3. In same pan, melt 2 tbsp butter, add 3 minced garlic cloves, cook 30 sec.
4. Add 1 bunch trimmed asparagus, sauté 3–4 min until crisp-tender.
5. Stir in juice of 1 lemon, ¼ cup chicken broth, and 1 tsp dried thyme; simmer 1 min.
6. Return chicken to pan to warm through. Garnish with parsley. Serve with microwave rice or crusty bread.
